rubrics.justification: Generally reasonable blastocyst description, but it speculates about partial collapse and suggests the image may look closer to stage 3 despite the provided 2AA label; some features are inferred beyond what a single static image can confirm.

Integrates age, DOR, prior failed cycle, endometrial thickness, BMI, lifestyle, and semen parameters well, and appropriately emphasizes age-related aneuploidy as the main limiter despite good morphology.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, linking morphology plus uterine factors to prognosis while acknowledging ploidy uncertainty; minor imprecision remains around implantation vs clinical pregnancy terminology.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based: supports single embryo transfer, standard luteal support, avoidance of routine add-ons, and cautious use of PGT-A in DOR. Minor deviations include overconfident probability framing and some grading-stage commentary.

Provides practical next steps for current transfer and future planning, including SET, luteal support, avoiding bed rest/add-ons, and when to consider further workup or PGT-A. Useful though not highly protocol-specific.
